newsitem.title: USA: Beverly to redeem $150mln convertible debt.
newsitem.headline: Beverly to redeem $150mln convertible debt.

text.p: Beverly Enterprises Inc said Thursday it will redeem about $150 million of its 5.50 percent percent convertible subordinated debentures due August 1, 2018.
We've focused on strengthening our balance sheet and on simplifying our capital structure," said chief executive David Banks in a statement.
The company said it will redeem the debentures August 18 at 103.3 percent of the principal amount, plus accrued interest at a rate of $0.129861 per $50 principal amount.
It added the right to convert the debentures into Beverly common stock will expire at the close of business on August 15.

Beverly said if all the debentures were converted, the outstanding shares of the company's common stock would increase by about 11.25 million and its annual interest expense would be reduced by $8.25 million.
